in_marathi.name: Nikhil
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nikhil हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Nikhil originates from the Sanskrit language and means 'Victory' or 'Complete'. It is a powerful name in Hindu mythology, symbolizing triumph over challenges and completion of goals.

vedic_reference.note: The name Nikhil is derived from the Sanskrit word निखिल (nikhila) meaning 'complete' or 'all'. It is a common name in Hindu culture and is often given to babies born on New Year's Day or during festivals signifying new beginnings.
